page.notes: Marginal notes in left margin: "Epiphan. haeref. 71.", "Athanas. de Synodo & Apost. 2,", "Sozom. l. 4. cap. 16.", "Socrat. l. 2. cap. 31.", "Theod. l. 2. cap. 27." are transcribed above as a foot note with their references; the left margin also carries the printed reference marks. Some margin readings are uncertain; the wording of the side notes is approximate. The Latin word at the end of the text reads "brofius" as printed, likely Ambrosius with the initial letters damaged; transcribed as printed. Ornaments below the text are not transcribed. The heading "CAPUT" is a chapter heading at the foot.
